name: Natsume Ooe
source: Hanako's classmate and member of Yamaku's newspaper club, Natsume suffers from rheumatoid arthritis, as well as partial low vision in her right eye due to heterochromia. Sometimes compared to a less extreme and bossy [url=https://vndb.org/c149316]Shizune[/url], Natsume is responsible, stern and serious, a foil to her loud and upbeat friend and clubmate [url=https://vndb.org/c149257]Naomi[/url].
